messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["eagle", "octopus"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large standing bird of prey shown in right-facing profile with dense brown plumage, an eagle-like head with a hooked yellow-and-black beak and yellow eye, folded feathered wings on the sides of the body, two thick feathered legs ending in yellow scaly feet with black talons, and a cluster of long mottled brown tentacles bearing pale suckers hanging down from the rear underside where a tail would be, with patches of sucker-like spots also visible on the feathered thighs.", "extra_limb_pieces": 7, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "eagle", "part": "head", "where": "at the top front of the body, facing right"}, {"looks_like": "eagle", "part": "beak", "where": "at the front of the head"}, {"looks_like": "eagle", "part": "eye", "where": "on the side of the head"}, {"looks_like": "eagle", "part": "wings", "where": "folded on the left and right sides of the body"}, {"looks_like": "eagle", "part": "legs", "where": "below the body, supporting the body"}, {"looks_like": "eagle", "part": "feet", "where": "at the bottom of the legs, with black talons"}, {"looks_like": "eagle", "part": "feathers", "where": "covering the head, neck, body, wings and upper legs"}, {"looks_like": "octopus", "part": "tentacles", "where": "hanging down from the rear underside of the body in place of a tail"}, {"looks_like": "octopus", "part": "markings", "where": "circular sucker spots on the feathered thighs and lower body"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 0, "walking_legs": 2, "wings": 2}
